atoms.b: Located in Colombia, Caño Cristales is considered one of the most beautiful and unique ((road ++river)) systems in the world.
For just a few months each year, lower water levels allow more ((rain ++sunlight)) to reach the river bed, causing red and yellow algae to grow rapidly.

atoms.b: Due to its isolated location, the river is very ((easy ++hard)) to access. There are also strict restrictions in place to protect it from mass tourism.

atoms.a: With a height of 979 m, Angel Falls in Venezuela is the tallest, uninterrupted waterfall in the world.
It is located within the Guiana Shield. This vast region spans six countries and is covered by thick rainforests and extensive river systems.
The region is also home to some of the oldest rock formations on Earth, such as its flat-topped mountains called tepuis, which are billions of years old.
atoms.sound: The region is also home to some of the oldest rock formations on Earth, such as its flat-topped mountains called tepuease, which are billions of years old.

atoms.a: It is one of the most isolated and biodiverse ecosystems on the planet and is home to many unique species, such as the dyeing poison dart frog.

finish.text: Natural resources like oil and gold are the main exports of the countries known collectively as the Guianas: Guyana, Suriname and French Guiana.

hint.label: Afro-Caribbean
hint.text: The term Afro-Caribbean describes the people of African descent who come from or live in the Caribbean and the mixed culture of these two regions.

atoms.text: Due to colonialism and migration, these Northern South American countries form part of the wider Afro-Caribbean world, which shares a rich history, culture and cuisine.
Dishes such as rice and beans cooked in coconut milk are common in these regions and are often served with fresh seafood, grilled meats and tropical fruits.

Music styles like reggaeton are widely listened to across the Afro-Caribbean world, and dance styles such as salsa have evolved to combine South American, Spanish and Afro-Caribbean elements together.
